title: SchemaField
description: One schema field of a portal type.

type.description: Archetypes field type (e.g. `string`, `reference`) or the Dexterity zope.schema class name (e.g. `TextLine`).

readonly.description: True when the field cannot be written through the API.

allowed_types.description: Reference fields only: the portal types the field may point to.

multi_valued.description: Present when the field declares whether it holds one value or many.
